relation.rationale: Difference in long s (ſ) vs short s (s) and case (lowercase vs capitalized).

The difference between 'mahlen' and 'mahlem' is a graphic variant of the final -n/-m (long s vs. m or similar orthographic variation), while the punctuation difference is secondary to the word form variation in the primary comparison.
Difference in the graphic representation of the umlaut (u vs uͤ) and the spelling of the prefix (wo vs war), which are orthographic variants of the same word form.
Jeſu and Jeſus are alternative spellings of the same name (vocative vs nominative form often conflated in early modern texts), differing by the final 's'.
Difference in the vowel representation (e vs. ä) and consonant cluster (k vs. ck) for the same word form.
The readings differ between the noun 'gnaden' (grace) and the adjective 'genädig' (merciful/gracious), which are distinct words with different grammatical functions.
The first reading 'gnaden' (noun, dative plural) is replaced by 'genaͤdig' (adjective/adverb) in the other editions, representing a change in word class and wording.
The words 'recht' and 'noch' are different words with different meanings.
Gib (give) and Schaff (create/make) are different verbs with different meanings.
